# falcon-v1.143.0 — cleanup: the board and the V mean what they say

A cleanup release with no interface change. v1.143 was re-scoped on 2026-11-19 (S1) to the implemented set, cut when each artifact is promoted or moved with a reason. Owner decisions on 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25 moved what the gate cannot execute to v1.144. Wire decoders that were wrong are fixed against reference libraries. Every Cargo.lock and the Bazel lock are committed and enforced. The promotion rule is now a checked census rather than a judgement.

## What this tag actually verifies

The 22 artifacts scoped to `falcon-v1.143.0` are all `verified` (`scripts/release-readiness.rs --release falcon-v1.143.0`: 22/22):

| requirement | what it asserts |
|---|---|
| `SWREQ-FALCON-RATE-P05` | the inner rate loop tracks its command under load instead of limit-cycling into the rails |
| `SWREQ-FALCON-FAULT-P03` | single-rotor-out FDI stays robust under sensor noise |
| `SWREQ-FALCON-MAVLINK-P07` | MAVLink2 frames with any incompat flag are rejected until signing exists (#679) |
| `SWREQ-FALCON-MISSIONUP-P02` | an uploaded mission is validated item by item, staged, and committed whole (#680, #701) |
| `SWREQ-FALCON-OCI-P04` | the WIT interface package is published and claims the `falcon` namespace |
| `SWREQ-FALCON-REL-P01` | a failed release leaves no published release, not a partial one |
| `SWREQ-SEC-P01`..`P07` | relay-sec: anti-replay, Ascon-AEAD128 per-frame authentication, total pre-auth header parsing, authenticate-before-parse, AEAD confidentiality without downgrade, X25519 session keys, a transport-agnostic channel |
| `SWREQ-SB-P01` | the software bus `no_std` pluggable backend seam |
| `SWREQ-FALCON-TRACE-P01` | every shipped sw-req carries a `release:` (19 backfilled; the query returns 0) |
| `SWREQ-FALCON-TRACE-P02` | promotion follows executed evidence; the census is re-derived by `scripts/trace-census.rs --check` |
| `SYSREQ-FALCON-021` | field-operable infrastructure: parameters and calibration persist, a crash-surviving blackbox, bit-exact replay, telemetry and in-flight tuning |

**SYSREQ-FALCON-021 is the first system requirement at `verified`.** `SYSV-RELAY-FALCON-021` maps each clause to a verified sw-req (PARAM-P03, CALIB-P02, LOG-P02, LOG-P03, MAVLINK-P06) and fails if any child of the requirement is unverified. It claims no on-vehicle evidence. `FEAT-FALCON-first-flight-hw` stays `approved`.

**Re-verified, not newly delivered:** the TRACE-P02 sweep (#738) promoted 7 sw-reqs whose verifiers executed every step and passed (55 PASS, 0 FAIL, 0 skipped): FOLLOW-P01, LOITER-P01, REL-P02, WASMEQ-P02, RELAY-VGATE-P02, RELAY-BP-P02 and TRACE-P01. Their `release:` fields name the release that delivered them. The other 57 `implemented` sw-reqs are named in TRACE-P02 with one reason each.

**Candidate:** the merge of #743 on top of `24cee5f`. The merge-queue verification gate on `24cee5f` ran every falcon step (run 45887762221): 201 passed, 0 failed, 21 skipped as bench-only, 11 artifacts with no steps. #743 changes no Rust source and no falcon-tagged artifact; it makes Bazel green again (#715).

## Fixes

- **relay-mavlink:**
  - MAVLink2 frames with any incompat flag are rejected; signed frames had been obeyed with the signature ignored (#679).
  - Payloads whose trailing zero bytes were truncated are zero-extended (#675, #676).
- **falcon-mavlink, falcon-core:**
  - uploaded mission items are validated and the mission is committed whole; hostile altitudes cut the motors (#680);
  - the supervisor refuses a mission of more than 16 waypoints whole (before, the extra waypoints were dropped and the truncated mission loaded) and admits only waypoints within the geofence radius minus 2 m (#701).
- **relay-dronecan, relay-notch:** `read_int` sign-extends a 63-bit field without overflow (#674).
- **Conformance:** seven wire decoders (relay-mavlink, relay-dronecan, falcon-gnss-ubx) are checked against reference-library vectors (#678).
- **relay-hk, relay-sc:** the shipped copies get the guards their Verus copies already prove (#681).
- **falcon-cascade-stream:** the six `monitor` exports are declared `async func`, as the current Component Model async ABI requires for `canon lift async`; meld 0.69 rejected the composed component (#715, #743).
- **Security advisories:** wasmtime 45.0.1 → 50.0.3 (RUSTSEC-2026-0587, #716, #718) and url 2.5.8 → 2.5.9 (RUSTSEC-2026-0592, #723).

## Verification structure

- **The verification gate fails a run that checked nothing**, guards test filters after `--`, and Verus is a required check (#686). Verus's `external_body` trust has a per-crate ceiling (#684).
- **Trust ledger:** a `kani::assume` ledger, shrink-only trust totals and a Rocq kernel-axiom audit (#708); `sin_approx`/`cos_approx` audited with a measured trusted base (#714). 21 Kani harnesses drop or widen assume bounds they did not need (#673).
- **Mutation:** 16 tests in relay-fsafe and relay-preflight kill mutants the existing suites let through (#683).
- **Engine mirrors:** converged plain mirrors are held to the verus-strip of their Verus source, including relay-mm and relay-to (#692, #697).
- **The soak judges RATE-P05's own bars** on an unfaulted gz hover (#702).
- **Requirements say what the code does,** with a test pinning each boundary (#693).

## Supply chain and CI

- **Locks:** every workspace commits its Cargo.lock, builds with `--locked`, and all 23 locks are audited (#718). Bazel enforces `MODULE.bazel.lock` with `lockfile_mode=error` (#720), and a verify-only check prints the fix and uploads the regenerated lock when it is stale (#737).
- **Signing path (release.yml):** release binaries and components build with `--locked` (#719), `CARGO_BAZEL_REPIN` is dropped from the component bundle (#721), rustc is pinned to 1.100.0 (#724), and hosted jobs are pinned to ubuntu-24.04 (#696).
- **Pins:** dtolnay/rust-toolchain and setup-bazel are pinned to full commit SHAs (#712); rustc 1.100.0 on every other toolchain step (#722); setup-bazel 0.19.2 and install-action v2.90.4 (#700).
- **Self-hosted runners:** fork PRs are stopped by plant guard, pinned at v0.2.0 (#689, #695, #699).
- **Dependabot:** grouped monthly, actions as one group (#734).
- **Toolchain:** varve covalent layer 2026.11.16 (#703).

## Retired and new

- **Retired:** relay-arm and relay-modextra. **Parked:** relay-traj and precision landing (ORPHAN-P01, #687).
- **New, for v1.144 (not verified in this release):**
  - falcon-plant, the SITL plant as a library with a lockstep tick interface (PLANT-P01, `implemented`, #709);
  - a CI job lowering falcon-cascade through meld, loom and synth that reports per-target reach (CHAIN-P01, still `draft`, #707);
  - relay-bp S1, the BPv7 codec (#733), whose P01, P03..P07 stay `implemented` and are targeted to v1.145.

## Release assets

- **No x86_64-apple-darwin asset** from this release on (#710). x86_64 and aarch64 Linux, aarch64-apple-darwin and x86_64 Windows continue.

## Moved to falcon-v1.144.0 (owner decisions 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25)

- **49 artifacts from batch 1 (#731),** each with an inline reason: 7 owner-held, 16 cFS-port requirements whose verifiers have no runnable steps, and 26 the gate does not run (not falcon-tagged, bench-only, or needing build-host tools).
- **`SYSREQ-FALCON-022`** (thesis).
- **Known limit A (#638) is not fixed.** The v1.141 host contract stands: `sensor-frame.dt-s` must be a steady period. The plan carries it in v1.144 without holding that tag.
- **`SWREQ-FALCON-REFVEC-P01` (#376),** per-tick reference vectors at the partition seam, slipped from v1.143. It is the first v1.144 slice and is never cut.

## Falsification statement

This release is wrong if `scripts/trace-census.rs --check` or `SYSV-RELAY-FALCON-021`'s queries fail on this tag's tree; if any of the 22 v1.143 artifacts is not `verified` on this tag; if a MAVLink2 frame with an incompat flag set is acted on by falcon-mavlink; if a mission with more than 16 waypoints loads truncated instead of being refused whole; or if a waypoint farther than the geofence radius minus 2 m is admitted.

## ⚠️ Disclosures

- **No independent review covers this release.** The diff `falcon-v1.142.0..` was checked only by the per-PR gates and the merge queue.
- **Most residual evidence is still unexecuted.** 57 `implemented` sw-reqs remain, named in TRACE-P02: 32 have no step the gate executes, 8 have their substance skipped as bench-only, and 5 cFS verifiers have no steps. The gate runs only falcon-tagged artifacts (#601).
- **ASPICE level coverage:** rivet's schema expects a sys-integration verifier for every system requirement and unit and integration verifiers for every sw-req. No system requirement has one, and 163 verified sw-reqs show the gap. Verification is carried by sw-verification and sys-verification artifacts.
- **The fused P3 stream artifact is withdrawn.** `falcon-cascade-stream-fused` is no longer bundled: meld cannot fuse stream built-ins yet (meld ADR-10 step 6). The copy in v1.142's signed bundle cannot run: its core module imports four functions named `"" "0"` to `"" "3"`, the unresolved stream shim imports of meld#558, which no host can serve. Earlier bundles were not inspected. `falcon-cascade-stream-composed` still ships. FV-RELAY-STREAM-012 and -013 stay `implemented` and carry a note (#715).
- **#726** (grouped github-actions bump touching release.yml) is not in this release; it awaits maintainer review.
